title: Autonomy Policy
description: Per-project autonomy configuration (ADR-0014). Written to .aiecp/policy.local.yaml or .aiecp/policy.yaml in the host repo. No workflow may exceed the declared level for a given capability regardless of what the workflow definition requests (docs/security-model.md).

default.description: L0 Observe, L1 Suggest, L2 Modify safely, L3 Test + repair autonomously, L4 Multi-step autonomous execution, L5 Autonomous engineering with safety gates.

allow.description: Per-capability grants. Each value is either a fixed grant or 'ask'/'deny'/'scoped'. This is the floor beneath autonomy.default — a capability set to 'deny' here can never be exercised regardless of level.

broad_refactor_threshold.description: Defines when a change is classified as 'broad-refactor' and therefore requires the broad-refactor safety gate (docs/security-model.md).
